source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of infrared spectroscopy (PDF 192-193).

blocks.text: Tamam covalent bonds kuch kuch springs ki tarah kaam karte hain aur kai tareeqon se vibrate (thartharate) kar sakte hain. In vibrations ki frequencies electromagnetic spectrum ke infrared hisse mein hoti hain. Agar organic molecule par aisi infrared energy daali jaye jo us ke bonds ki natural (qudrati) vibration frequency ke barabar ho, to molecule us energy ka kuch hissa absorb kar leta hai aur vibration ka amplitude (phailao) barh jata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar sketches, har aik mein bara blue atom springs se do chhote yellow atoms ke saath jura hai; opposite (ulti) simt ke cyan teeron ke jore motion (harkat) dikhate hain: symmetric stretching aur asymmetric stretching (linear, yani seedhe molecule; teer bonds ke saath; symmetric mein barabar, asymmetric mein chhote aur lambe), aur symmetric bending aur asymmetric bending (bent, yani mude hue molecule; teer bonds ke across (aar-paar); symmetric mein barabar, asymmetric mein chhote aur lambe).
blocks.caption: Figure 29.6: Molecules mein vibration (thartharahat) ke different modes (tareeqe) (kitab ki Figure 29.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Stretching mein bond lamba aur chhota hota hai (atoms aik line mein aage peeche); bending mein bonds ke darmiyan ka angle badalta hai. Symmetric mein dono taraf aik saath aik jaisi harkat hoti hai, asymmetric mein aik taraf phailta hai to doosri taraf sikurta hai.

Infrared (IR) spectroscopy compounds pehchanne ki technique hai. Yeh is baat par based hai ke khaas frequencies ki IR absorb karne se atoms ki vibrations badal jati hain. Spectrophotometer sample par IR radiation daalta hai aur phir detect karta (pakarta) hai ke molecule ne kitni radiation absorb ki. IR energy sirf tab absorb hoti hai jab molecule ka permanent dipole ho jo vibrate karte hue badle. Is liye O₂ ya H₂ jaise symmetrical aur non-polar molecules IR inactive hain (IR absorb nahi karte). O-H, N-H jaise polar bonds zyada wavenumbers par absorption dikhate hain. Isi tarah chhoti bond length wale bonds aur multiple bonds (maslan HC≡CH) bhi zyada wavenumbers par absorb karte hain, kyun ke yeh bonds strong (mazboot) hain aur zyada energy maangte hain. IR spectrum ke do regions (hisse) hain: 1500 cm⁻¹ se neeche fingerprint region aur 1500 cm⁻¹ se oopar functional group region. Yahan sirf functional group region study kiya jayega, jo organic compound ki nature (qisam) pehchanne ke liye kaafi hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Wavenumber (cm⁻¹) jitna zyada, energy utni zyada. Strong ya polar bonds (O-H, N-H, triple bonds) ko vibrate karne ke liye zyada energy chahiye, is liye un ki peaks spectrum ke baen (left, zyada wavenumber) hisse mein aati hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Sarak ke kinare (roadside) police ke modern breathalyser mein infrared spectroscopy se alcohol ki amount (miqdar) naapi ja sakti hai. Breathalyser ke chamber mein chhori gayi saans mein se infrared ki ray (shua) guzari jati hai. Ethanol ke khaas bonds detect aur measure kiye jate hain: infrared ki absorbance jitni zyada, saans mein ethanol utna zyada.
Neeche ka table infrared absorption frequencies (wavenumbers) batata hai.

blocks.prompt: O₂ aur N₂ IR spectroscopy mein kyun nazar nahi aate, jab ke CO₂ aati hai?
blocks.explanation: O₂ aur N₂ ka koi dipole nahi, aur in ki akeli vibration (stretching) se bhi dipole nahi banta, is liye yeh IR absorb nahi karte. CO₂ ke bonds polar hain; is ki asymmetric stretching aur bending dipole badalti hain, is liye CO₂ IR absorb karti hai.

items: Bonds vibrate karte hain (stretching, bending); dipole badle to IR absorb hoti hai.
Functional group region 1500 cm⁻¹ se oopar; fingerprint region neeche.
